description: Get neutral CBS (Statistics Netherlands) figures for a Dutch municipality, district or neighbourhood: headline figures and a few per category (housing, population, income, energy, nearby amenities and more), each with its period and the comparison with the wider area and the Netherlands, plus source attribution. Huisly does not score or rank areas. Pass a place name, or type and slug from resolve_place.

categories.description: Only these categories, with more figures each

language.description: Language of huisly.nl links and of area-figure labels: en (default) or nl

place.description: A municipality, district or neighbourhood name

name: get_place_insights
title: Get area statistics
